# Indian Broker Test

> Independent, data-driven comparison of Indian stock brokers, built only from verifiable published information. No broker affiliation, sponsorship or referral fees. Where a broker does not publish a figure, it is shown as "Not Disclosed" - never estimated or invented. Every number is cited to its source.

Key facts about this site:

- Covers 16 major Indian stock brokers: Zerodha, Upstox, Groww, Angel One, Dhan, Fyers, ICICI Direct, Kotak Neo, 5paisa, Alice Blue, Paytm Money, Pocketful, Arrow, Sahi, Shoonya (Finvasia) and IIFL.
- On the fastest broker in India: Arrow publishes the lowest self-reported figure (95% of orders under 2.9 ms, measured from AWS Mumbai); among independently measured brokers (AlgoTest Broker Speedtest), Zerodha and Kotak Neo are fastest at ~80 ms median round-trip. Self-reported and third-party figures use different methodologies and are not directly comparable.
- Rankings are computed only from published, verifiable data; methodology is public.

- [Best stock brokers in India](https://www.indianbrokertest.com/best-stock-brokers-in-india/): Full comparison of brokerage, AMC, platforms, APIs and execution speed.
- [Lowest brokerage brokers in India](https://www.indianbrokertest.com/lowest-brokerage-brokers-in-india/): Delivery, intraday and F&O charges for every tracked broker, from official pricing pages.
- [Best trading APIs in India](https://www.indianbrokertest.com/best-trading-apis-in-india/): Every documented broker API with pricing and official docs.
- [Best brokers for algo trading](https://www.indianbrokertest.com/best-brokers-for-algo-trading/): APIs, algo-platform support and execution data for systematic traders.
- [Best brokers for active traders](https://www.indianbrokertest.com/best-brokers-for-active-traders/): Costs and tooling for high-frequency discretionary trading.
